name: MoreHead-to-Head 2023

venue.name: Adron Doran University Center (ADUC)
venue.details: Ballrooms A, B, and C on Third Floor of ADUC

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MoreHeadToHead2023#28221-competitor-information).

This competition is in partnership with the Morehead State Math Department
